recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist composition featuring a row of human feet dangling from the top edge of the frame into a vast, misty twilight sky that transitions into a low-lying landscape of rolling hills and fog.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical tension between the top-heavy human elements and the low-horizon landscape.
Contrast between the warm, fleshy tones of the feet and the cool, deep blues of the sky.
Scale disparity between the large foreground feet and the distant, miniature hills.
coreInvariants: Bare feet entering from the top frame edge
Deep blue to cyan vertical sky gradient
Low-lying mist or fog in the bottom third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Human feet are positioned at the extreme top, acting as a ceiling; the landscape is compressed at the bottom fifth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central handwritten text serves as the focal point in the negative space of the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top with the feet, drop through the vast blue negative space to the text, and settle on the misty horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive central negative space occupied by the sky gradient.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and cerulean blue sky gradient.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm terracotta and peach tones of the human skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the text and distant stars/mist.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and dark sky; low saturation in the distant landscape to create depth.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Wide tracking, thin geometric strokes, all-caps.
Center text: Fluid, connected cursive with variable line weight, mimicking white ink or paint.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders on the script to emphasize the 'falling' or 'hanging' theme.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, spaced-out geometric caps and organic, fluid personal script.

preserve: Extreme tracking for the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, clean look of the top metadata.
Captures the personal, organic feel of the central title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A surreal landscape photo. The top edge features several pairs of realistic bare human feet dangling downward. The background is a vast twilight sky with a vertical gradient from dark indigo at the top to light cyan at the bottom. The bottom of the frame shows a distant horizon of dark green rolling hills partially obscured by thick white ground mist and fog. A few tiny stars are visible in the upper sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a line of all-caps sans-serif text across the very top, spaced widely so each letter sits between or near the dangling feet. In the center of the sky, add a line of white handwritten cursive script with a natural, flowing ink texture.

verificationChecks: Feet must appear to be hanging from the top frame edge.
Sky gradient must be smooth without banding.
Mist must look soft and volumetric.
Text must be pure white and legible against the blue.

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the top text

mustAchieve: Clean photographic realism for the feet
avoid: Cartoonish or illustrative rendering of the landscape

postGenerationChecks: Ensure feet do not look severed but rather like they are 'off the ground'.
Check that the white text doesn't get lost in the lighter part of the sky.
Verify the scale of the feet relative to the hills creates a sense of surrealism.
Confirm the top text is perfectly horizontal and evenly spaced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Levitation + Sky Gradient + Minimalist Typography
